format: single Club Pilates studio (typically 1,500 to 1,800 sq ft leased, 12 reformers)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Club Pilates studio is $413,289 to $1,029,811, which includes $197,901 to $241,189 that must be paid to franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: You must pay to us a lump sum initial franchise fee of $65,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") to establish a single Studio under a Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: VetFran veterans: $48,750. Existing franchisees' 2nd or subsequent Studio: $55,000. Sourcing fee of $28,000 (in addition) if a broker is owed a commission on an existing franchisee's additional franchise; $30,000 sourcing fee in lieu of the fee when buying an existing Studio through a broker. Multi-Unit Development Fee $10,000 per Studio less the first.

royalty.quote: Royalty 8% of Gross Sales generated by your Studio over the relevant reporting period Payable weekly via electronic funds transfer ("EFT") based on the Gross Sales of your Studio during the preceding business week

adFund.quote: Contributions to Brand Development Fund Currently, 2% of Gross Sales Payable weekly around the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty
adFund.note: Currently 2% Brand Development Fund; Local Advertising Requirement the greater of $1,500 or 2% of prior month's Gross Sales; Fund + Co-Op + local advertising capped in aggregate at 7% per month (Marketing Expenditure Cap). Initial marketing spend $33,300 to $46,600.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $550/month (may increase 10% annually); reduced $150 per month during Pre-Sales Phase

otherRecurring.name: Local Advertising Requirement
otherRecurring.amount: The greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales, monthly

otherRecurring.name: Music Licensing Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Amounts charged by the providers and/or applicable performing rights organizations (PROs)

otherRecurring.name: Mystery Shopper and Other Quality Control Programs

transferFee.amount: $10,000 Upon your request for our consent to any proposed transfer (administrative fee of $750 to an entity you fully own, or $1,500 to an immediate family member)

special: Fitness Equipment & Initial FF&E Package ($128,986 to $170,034) and pre-opening items must be purchased from the franchisor or its affiliate, making up most of the $197,901 to $241,189 paid to the franchisor. Sourcing fees ($28,000 to $120,000) apply when a franchise broker is owed a commission.
